recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochrome composition featuring vertical strips of 35mm film contact sheets arranged side-by-side against a solid black background, topped with bold, heavy sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical repetition of film strips creating a rhythmic grid
High-contrast black and white imagery against a deep black void
Bold white typography anchored at the top center
Candid, grainy photographic textures contrasting with clean graphic lines
coreInvariants: Visible film sprocket holes and frame edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Seven vertical film strips occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold white title at the top center acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the title down into the vertical columns, scanning the individual frames of the contact sheets.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant black negative space at the top and bottom margins creates a sense of focus and weight.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for typography and highlights in the photography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays within the film grain to provide detail.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between the black background and white highlights.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Forward slash used as a stylistic separator between words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy typeface for maximum impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and wide stance.
Provides the necessary vertical presence and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a collage of seven vertical 35mm film contact strips featuring grainy, high-contrast black and white candid photos of a rock band performing. The strips should have visible sprocket holes and be set against a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of centered, extra-bold, uppercase white sans-serif text at the top, using a forward slash to separate the two main phrases.

verificationChecks: Are the film strips vertically aligned?
Is the text extra-bold and uppercase?

adjustableVariables: Vertical spacing between text and imagery
mustRedesign: Specific frame numbers or edge markings
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleed in the monochrome images.
Check that the text is perfectly centered.
Verify that the film strips look like physical cut-outs.
Confirm the typography is heavy enough to balance the visual weight of the strips.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Rock Band] in [Format: Vertical Film Strips] with [Style: High-Contrast B&W] and [Typography: Extra-Bold Sans-Serif] on [Background: Solid Black].
